concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-issuing-manage-network-tokens]] — 2026-09-15-captured Issuing guide for card-linked digital-wallet network-token lookup, asynchronous status updates and example transaction rules; flags path/type inconsistencies and the authorization-rule versus token-count-limit ambiguity.
warnings: The guide's single-token and PATCH operation links use `/networkTokens/{networkTokenId}`, while their curl samples use a nested payment-instrument path; list and single-token `type` tables also differ.
The one-per-card example creates an authorization transaction rule with `activeNetworkTokens`; it does not establish a provisioning-time enforcement result.
